aliases_note: Agent 1's translator table. Every client export is messy in its own way; each target field lists the source column names we accept, matched case-insensitively and ignoring punctuation/underscores. Consumed as data by engine/ingest.py.
unmapped_policy: Unknown source columns are kept verbatim in debtor_records.raw_record and reported in the mapping summary as unmapped; no field is ever silently dropped.
